name: Statement of Work (SOW)
objective: Extract project milestones, deliverable descriptions, and payment timelines.

attributes.name: SOW Title / Reference
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the SOW title or reference number.

attributes.name: Parent Agreement
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the parent MSA/contract this SOW is issued under.

attributes.name: Project End Date
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the project end / target completion date.

attributes.name: Project Description
attributes.extractionPrompt: Summarise the overall project scope and objectives.

attributes.name: Line Items
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract each deliverable/milestone as a row with description, quantity, unit price and amount.

attributes.name: Total Project Value
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the total contract value of the SOW.

attributes.name: Payment Schedule
attributes.extractionPrompt: Summarise the payment/billing schedule tied to milestones.

attributes.name: Project Manager
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the named project manager / point of contact.
